quick_skim.title: Task-Phase-Conditioned Expert Routing Is Not a Reliable Proxy for Quantization Sensitivity in MoE FFN Tensors
quick_skim.abstract: We investigate whether per-layer, per-task-phase (prompt/reasoning/response) expert-routing statistics in a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model can guide layer-wise mixed-precision quantization of routed-expert FFN tensors (down/gate and up). To attain layerwise routing statistics, we build a routing-capture and profiling pipeline for Qwen-3.6-35B-A3B in ik_llama.cpp, derive a composite sensitivity score from routing entropy/decisiveness, coefficient of variation (CV), Jaccard/phase-fragility, and top-1 expert strength, and use coordinate descent to tune a layer allocation that respects a fixed average bits-per-weight budget. Notably, the profiling pipeline is applicable to standard top-k MoE architectures. Across independent experimental conditions (about 4.0 bpw flat, about 2.7 bpw steep, and about 2.7 bpw random allocation as a control), reallocation fails to outperform the uniform baseline within each quality tier. In the flat regime, reallocation is statistically neutral (z about 0.9). For the steep tier, the random reallocation performs within 1 SE of the routing-guided reallocation at the same tier, indicating a structural loss at this quality rung caused by mandatory downgrades and Kullback-Leibler Divergence (KLD) tail injection. This aggressive-budget condition shows a decisive loss (z greater than 4 SE) replicated across three independent weight vectors. We argue that the deeper issue is that routing-behavior statistics are an unvalidated proxy for true per-layer quantization cost.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对混合专家大模型在低比特量化中难以确定各层精度分配的问题，本文研究路由统计能否作为量化敏感度代理。作者在Qwen-3.6-35B上构建路由捕获与剖析流程，融合路由熵、变异系数、相位脆弱性等指标构造复合敏感度分数，并用坐标下降在固定平均比特预算下求解逐层分配。实验表明基于任务相位的专家路由并不能可靠指示FFN张量的量化敏感度。该剖析流程可推广到标准top-k MoE结构，为混合精度量化提供诊断工具。

quick_skim.title: Not All Frames Are Equal:Difference-Aware Quantization for Ultra-Low-Bit ASR
quick_skim.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) methods such as GPTQ and AWQ compress large language models effectively, but applying them to automatic speech recognition (ASR) at ultra-low bit-widths (2-3 bits) causes severe transcription degradation. Unlike discrete text tokens, speech activations are highly correlated in steady-state and zero-padded regions yet change rapidly at phonetic boundaries; when all frames contribute equally to the Hessian, static frames dominate calibration and obscure informative transitions. We propose DiffAQ, which computes frame-to-frame activation differences to measure the rate of acoustic change and assigns Hessian importance proportionally, concentrating quantization precision on phonetically critical frames. As a training-free modification to GPTQ, DiffAQ consistently reduces WER across various Whisper sizes and standard benchmarks, with the largest gains at 2-bit precision where baseline methods frequently produce degenerate outputs.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: frame-difference-aware PTQ calibration built on GPTQ/AWQ Hessian weighting

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: DiffAQ shows that GPTQ/AWQ-style post-training quantization degrades ASR at 2-3 bits because static frames dominate Hessian calibration, and fixes it by weighting Hessian importance with frame-to-frame acoustic change.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 该文关注GPTQ、AWQ等训练后量化方法迁移到2-3比特语音识别时转写质量严重下降的问题，指出语音帧在稳态与零填充段高度相关、而在音素边界剧烈变化，若所有帧等权参与Hessian校准会被静态帧主导。作者提出DiffAQ，用帧间激活差异衡量声学变化速率并按比例分配Hessian重要性，把量化精度集中到音素关键帧。摘要表明该帧感知校准能缓解超低比特下的转写退化，为语音模型低比特部署提供了可迁移的校准思路。
